Volenta — Oathbreaker Bride of the Mask

Volenta is the male bride Madam Eva described: a fallen paladin who does not gorge on victims. He chooses them, seduces or dominates them, and drains them slowly over months. In combat he is the patient martial counterweight to Anastrasya: black plate, broken vows, punishing smites, control auras and deliberate pressure on isolated targets.

Arl — Contracted Pit Fiend

A pit fiend found trapped in the hidden summoning chamber beneath Wachter House. The session ended after the parties accepted the terms but before the contract was signed or Arl was released.
☾ ◆ ☽

dr.custom: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks that aren't Silvered

actions.name: Infernal Glaive
actions.description: Arl fights like a disciplined executioner, not a berserker. Against Orcus or an undead manifestation, one hit each turn deals +2d8 force.

actions.name: Hellchain
actions.description: Recharge 5–6. A target within 30 feet is bound by infernal chain. On a failure it is Restrained until the end of Arl’s next turn. Against Orcus, a successful containment beat also suppresses reactions until initiative 20.

actions.name: Ordered Inferno
actions.description: 30-foot cone or 20-foot burst. Arl can exclude the Unkindness because the contract requires mutual non-harm.

actions.name: Break the Corrupt Gate
actions.description: Once per major scene, Arl may destroy a mundane/lesser magical barrier or hold a Dark Power front for one pressure check. This is the practical value of sending him into Ravenloft first.

description.value: Arl makes two Infernal Glaive attacks.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing plus 13 (3d8) fire damage. Against Orcus or an undead manifestation, one hit each turn deals an extra 9 (2d8) force damage.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: DC 18 Strength saving throw. One target within 30 feet is bound by an infernal chain. On a failure it is also restrained until the end of Arl's next turn. description.value: Arl destroys a mundane or lesser magical barrier, or holds one Dark Power front for one pressure check. 1/encounter.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: Arl has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: Arl and the Unkindness can't intentionally harm one another while the Ravenloft contract is in force. It binds both sides.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: The party refused to owe a future favour. Arl is paid in truthful written recognition that his help materially aided Strahd's defeat. No souls and no service are owed.

Rudolph van Richten — Final Briefing

The hunter who reconstructed members of the Unkindness through soul-coin vessels. He is their final technical counsel before Ravenloft and remains in Vallaki to keep civilians alive.

actions.description: A prepared anti-undead shot. Van Richten is not intended to join the castle assault; this profile exists if Vallaki violence reaches his workshop.

actions.name: Monster Hunter’s Diagnosis

actions.name: Emergency Field Medicine
actions.description: Once per scene, stabilize a creature and restore 3d8+5 HP using prepared reagents.

description.value: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Counts as silvered and magical.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: One creature within 5 feet is stabilized and regains hit points from prepared reagents. 1/encounter.

description.value: Van Richten knows the Amber Temple's broken prisons changed Barovia's magic: cult symbols are now being answered by something outside them.

Saraphene — Shadar-kai Vampire Messenger

The shaved-headed vampire who delivered Strahd’s sealed invitation on the road. She warned that the castle is on full alert, Finn returned injured, Tatyana is protected, the brides are divided, and something important has been moved into one of Ravenloft’s three towers.
☾ ◆ ☽

actions.name: Shadow Blade
actions.description: Saraphene is dangerous but has explicitly asked not to fight the Unkindness.

actions.name: Mist Escape
actions.description: Transform into mist and withdraw from a scene unless artifact sunlight prevents it.

actions.name: Court Gossip

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: Saraphene teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space she can see; until the start of her next turn she is heavily obscured by shadow. 1/encounter.

source.book: The Shield Between Us: Ironfist Legacy

description.value: Saraphene turns to mist and withdraws from the scene, unless artifact sunlight is on her. 1/encounter.
